industries.fitnessSports.description: Robots that clean gyms, locker rooms and restrooms, underwater robots for pools, mowers and line markers for stadiums. A pilot in one zone of your club.
industries.fitnessSports.name: Fitness clubs and sports facilities
industries.fitnessSports.lead: Russian sanitary rules require every room in a sports facility to be wet-cleaned every day, and gyms, equipment, showers and locker rooms to be disinfected too. Yet the club is open from morning to night, so cleaning has to fit in between workouts.
industries.fitnessSports.lead2: Robots take over the gym and restroom floors, the pool bottom, the lawn and the field markings. People handle equipment, surface disinfection and quality checks.
industries.fitnessSports.photo.alt: A compact robotic floor scrubber drives around a bench in the free-weights area of a fitness club in the early morning
industries.fitnessSports.directions.item: The robot scrubs the gym floor along a set route, steers around the machines and returns to base on its own. We schedule it for hours when the gym is empty.
Compact robots for narrow aisles and restrooms, where a large scrubber can’t turn around.
Pudu SH1: for restrooms and tight spots
A professional robotic pool cleaner for large pools vacuums the basin at night or during the sanitary closure hour.

industries.fitnessSports.problems.title: Meeting sanitary rules with fewer people.
Every room is wet-cleaned every day.
Sports facilities must be wet-cleaned daily with detergents and disinfectants. Gyms and equipment (machines, mats), restrooms, showers, locker rooms and the first-aid room are disinfected every day.
Over 80% of cleaning staff are foreign nationals, and cleaning companies’ payroll has grown two- to threefold in five years. In 2025, 11 regions added new limits on hiring migrant workers.
Cleaning has to fit between workouts.
Cleaning happens when the gym is almost empty: early morning, late evening or off-peak lulls.
There’s more to clean than floors.
The pool basin, stadium lawn and field markings are separate jobs, each with its own schedule and equipment.

industries.fitnessSports.pilotLead: We found no public deployments of robots in Russian fitness clubs, so we don’t show anyone else’s numbers. We propose a pilot at your site: the result will be yours.
industries.fitnessSports.pilot.items.0.t: We walk the zones, measure areas and check floor surfaces, thresholds, aisles between machines and opening hours.
industries.fitnessSports.pilot.items.1.t: The gym is the easiest place to start: a large area, cleaned daily. The robot works before opening or off-peak.
industries.fitnessSports.pilot.items.2.t: We compare how much cleaning time the robots free up and how well cleanliness holds. Then we decide whether robots should take the locker rooms, pool or field.
industries.fitnessSports.vendorsLead: Pudu offers a dedicated sports and entertainment solution: CC1 for gyms, MT1 for large areas, SH1 for restrooms (per the manufacturer). We tailor equipment to your club’s area, flooring and opening hours.
industries.fitnessSports.why.title: Pilot first, then the fleet.
industries.fitnessSports.why.text: You can rent a robot for the pilot instead of buying right away. We select, launch and service equipment from different manufacturers for the gym, pool and field under SLA.

industries.fitnessSports.form.lead: We’ll bring a robot for a demo, run a route across your gym and suggest which zone to hand over first.
